scientific_integrity: The exact finite-state checks support the analytic recurrence proof but do not certify the all-size theorem. Numerical constants are approximate, and no independent audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: Centered resetting on odd paths with graph-neighbor deterministic endpoint reflection and unit-step geometric resetting only; the continuum limit was previously known; independent priority assessment outstanding.
title: Exact reset-odds convexity and a lattice correction for reflected-path cover times
